# Installation guide (v2)

## Prerequisites

- 2 GB RAM minimum
- 500 MB free disk space
- Administrator rights for the first install

## Steps

1. Download the installer from the customer portal.
2. Run the installer and accept the license agreement.
3. Sign in with your organization account when prompted.
4. Complete the setup wizard and run your first workflow.
